sketches.study_axis: asymmetric feedback acid bass; full-range residual feedback
sketches.intent: A dry, resonant acid-like bass. Harder notes open a voice-local filter; asymmetric diode-like feedback colors the resonant bite, rather than adding post-filter distortion. Full Rage with a more exposed filter range. Original r1 MIDI/source retained; r1 on a new AU also uses the new DSP. Use archived eval-039 audio for an exact old-engine comparison, not the r1 label alone.

sketches.study_axis: balanced feedback overdrive in a brass-like lead; full-range residual feedback
sketches.intent: A forceful brass-like lead with a short opening vowel and balanced feedback overdrive. Detached phrases expose each filter articulation; not an acoustic brass or transistor circuit model. Full Rage with a more exposed filter range. Original r1 MIDI/source retained; r1 on a new AU also uses the new DSP. Use archived eval-039 audio for an exact old-engine comparison, not the r1 label alone.

sketches.study_axis: soft feedback electric keys with independent chord articulation; full-range residual feedback
sketches.intent: Rounded electric keys with a brief independent FM strike and soft feedback saturation. Staggered chord entrances demonstrate that a new note does not retrigger the other voices' filter envelopes. Full Rage with a more exposed filter range. Original r1 MIDI/source retained; r1 on a new AU also uses the new DSP. Use archived eval-039 audio for an exact old-engine comparison, not the r1 label alone.

sketches.study_axis: slow beating pad with memory-shaped feedback rounding; full-range residual feedback
sketches.intent: A warm, slowly opening chord with near-unison beating and tape-inspired feedback compression/rounding. No tape recording, physical hysteresis or reversed room is claimed; ordinary Space remains downstream. Full Rage with a more exposed filter range. Original r1 MIDI/source retained; r1 on a new AU also uses the new DSP. Use archived eval-039 audio for an exact old-engine comparison, not the r1 label alone.

sketches.study_axis: short bright asymmetric feedback percussion; full-range residual feedback
sketches.intent: A short papery metallic hit. Biased hard feedback clipping and voice-local audio-rate cutoff FM make the bright edge; no noise samples, random hit variation or separate post-distortion stage. Full Rage with a more exposed filter range. Original r1 MIDI/source retained; r1 on a new AU also uses the new DSP. Use archived eval-039 audio for an exact old-engine comparison, not the r1 label alone.
